correctness.rationale: The Gödel-chain EARS operation tables are explicit. The scalar homomorphism normal form follows by preservation of x↔x, 0~∧0 and a↔b for a<b; two active source coordinates contradict preservation of u↔v=u~∧v. Compositions of the remaining coordinate choices provide the endomorphism monoid; idempotence forces root loops and prefix retractions. The weighted-star EGF follows from the labelled exponential formula. A standalone verifier exhaustively checks 15,024 scalar and 72,380 product-to-chain candidate maps, 811 endomorphism tables, full Boolean-square maps, and EGF coefficients.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The result is not claimed to introduce EARS, standard binomial coefficients, general species exponential formulas, or the known Gödel hom-set recurrence. The contribution is the mixed-signature coordinate normal form and its weighted idempotent exact census. Ordinary Heyting results supply only the nonnull scalar counts and cannot on their own infer the EARS idempotent EGF.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies a complete normal-form description of all maps in a natural family of finite algebras for the mixed intuitionistic fragment, a uniform exact Hom calculus for arbitrary chain products, a closed endomorphism count and a nontrivial weighted-rooted-star exponential generating function for every idempotent/retraction map. It displays a concrete categorical difference from ordinary Gödel homomorphisms (9 versus 4 endomorphisms of the four-element Boolean square) and yields an infinite family of exact spectra.
